title: Hofmann Forgeries
notes: ~280 individual articles A-Z; very high KG value (each = concept node)

footnotes.text: See Topic:Martin Harris’s Consultations with Scholars.

The forgery was called the “salamander letter” because in it Harris claimed that Joseph Smith was led to the Book of Mormon plates by a spirit who “transfigured himself from a white salamander in the bottom of the hole” where the plates were buried (D. Todd Christofferson, “The Prophet Joseph Smith” (BYU–Idaho devotional, Sept. 24, 2013),byui.edu.
